nina (eng-runtime): Heads-up: we finished the slim-path slice-fusion rollout to canary and the numbers look solid — p50 down ~14%, p95 down ~18%, p99 stable, and token cost down ~33% on chat workloads. :tada:
ajay: Nice!! what's 'slim-path' again? quick refresher?
nina (eng-runtime): It's the microkernel path that skips some generic dispatch layers for short-context requests (<=128 tokens). less kernel hops + tighter vector ops. We also enabled a small sticky-buffer to avoid repeated allocations.
morgan: Do we have the canary dashboard link? want to peek at region diffs & tail latencies.
nina (eng-runtime): dashboard: https://redwood-internal/perf/canaries/slim-path-v1 (redacted) — core numbers in the top-left. region-wise EU is seeing slightly better gains than us-west, probably due to seq-distribution.
sam - perf: Pulled the canary CSVs — attaching quick summary: p50 14% down, p95 18% down, p99 +/-2ms. cost per token estimate from bench job: -33% when batching at 8, -28% at burst-1.
sre-oncall: Any red flags in error rate or queue depth during the canary?
nina (eng-runtime): Error rates flat, no increase in grpc retries. queue depth on canary hosts went up mildly when we bumped microbatch size to 8 during the test peak, but latency stayed within SLO.
ajay: What's the rollback plan if we see noisy p99 spikes in prod?
nina (eng-runtime): Canary hook is a feature-flag rollback, immediate revert of slim-path and auto-evict of sticky-buffer. we've got an automated monitor that will flip if p99 exceeds baseline by 30% for 5m.
product-ops: This looks like a good callout for the next release note. can we get a one-liner summary and a delta table for docs?
sam - perf: I'll draft a table with p50/p95/p99 + cost delta per model family and drop it in the release PR.
morgan: Any impact on embeddings or rerank endpoints? those are short but higher qps.
nina (eng-runtime): Embeddings: neutral (we skip slim-path for the large batched embedding workload). Rerank: small latency win (~7%) in low-latency single-shot flows.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary slim-path-v1 -> 3 hosts started at 3276543600 by nina (eng-runtime). health checks: passing.
sre-oncall: Thanks — I'll watch SLO alerts for the next 3 hours and report back if anything weird.
ajay: Can we add a quick perf test to the CI that asserts no regressions for 50/95/99 across the short-context profile?
nina (eng-runtime): Yes — I'll add a short-test to the e2e perf harness and gate the next canary promotion.
product-ops: tagging docs: @maria-docs please add a 'runtime improvements' blurb and link to the canary dashboard.
maria-docs: on it, will add the blurb + the delta table from sam.
sam - perf: Follow-ups: 1) run microbench on larger sequence lengths to ensure no regressions, 2) check cold-start mem usage on slim-path hosts, 3) confirm cost model changes in billing sim.
nina (eng-runtime): All of those are on my list for the next 48h. If anyone sees anything odd ping me or @sre-oncall.
morgan: Huge win — great work team :clap:
